summary: Tested backend (pytest 7/7 passed) and frontend (landing page, modal, validation, submission, redirect, mobile responsive). All features working end-to-end. Resend integration confirmed: POST /api/leads returned real email_id 3df17854-4732-4fad-ad74-ab97df16a760. Frontend correctly navigates to digistore24 redirect URL (which further 302s to your-creatory.com as expected affiliate behavior).

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid="ebook-mockup" is rendered TWICE in the DOM (once for mobile <lg breakpoint inside the copy column, once for desktop on the right). data-testid attributes should be unique per page. Recommend differentiating (e.g., ebook-mockup-mobile, ebook-mockup-desktop) or using CSS-only show/hide on a single instance.

action_items: (Optional) Deduplicate data-testid="ebook-mockup" by using mobile/desktop suffixed testids or a single instance with responsive classes.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is initialized AFTER it is referenced at module-level use (logging.basicConfig is at the bottom, but logger usage inside create_lead works because handler runs later). Still, consider moving the logging.basicConfig + logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) to the top of the file for clarity and to avoid future race conditions.
Duplicate data-testid in LandingPage.jsx (ebook-mockup appears in both mobile and desktop blocks).
Backend has no rate limiting on /api/leads - public endpoint that triggers email sending could be abused; consider adding simple rate limiting / IP throttling before production.
